name: r-data-wrangling
description: Research data import, types, labels, transformations and integration with editable tidyverse-first R code.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve research data meaning in editable R.
interface.longDescription: Import and prepare research tables with explicit types, identifiers, labels, missing-value meanings, joins, reshaping and declared aggregation rules. Keep native R operations visible and distinguish data preparation from inferential method decisions.
defaultPrompt: Import this research table while preserving identifiers, labels and missing-value meanings.
Join these research tables using their actual observation units and check match coverage.
Reshape these repeated observations and apply the specified aggregation rule.
